_comment: Hand-maintained register of every tracked exception/finding this repository carries, cross-referenced with the machine-generated secreport.json/vex.json (cmd/secreport). Update this file in the same PR that changes an exception's scope or review date.

entries.title: 26 pre-existing npm audit findings in website/ (Docusaurus dev-tooling deps)
entries.affected_component: website/package-lock.json (tinypool, webpack-dev-server, sockjs, serialize-javascript, copy-webpack-plugin, css-minimizer-webpack-plugin, uuid, @svgr/*, deepmerge)
entries.fixed_version: none safe -- npm's own suggested fix is a Docusaurus DOWNGRADE to 3.7.0 (older than the pinned 3.10.2), rejected: not a safe/compatible fix, risks breaking @docusaurus/theme-mermaid and the local-search plugin
entries.exploitability_context: build/dev-tooling only (npm start, docusaurus build) -- none of the affected packages ship in website/build/, the deployed static site
entries.environment: local development and CI build tooling, not the published site
entries.remediation: a dedicated Docusaurus major-version migration, tested against theme-mermaid/local-search compatibility, as its own reviewable change
entries.status: closed 2026-11-13 (GitHub issue closed by maintainer, stateReason COMPLETED; no linked PR). The technical control remains live and enforced in CI regardless of issue-tracker state: website/.security/npm-audit-baseline.json still gates on this exact baseline.

entries.title: Verify F2 documentation site mobile layout in a real browser
entries.exploitability_context: not applicable -- this is a layout/UX verification task, not a security finding
entries.remediation: manual verification in a real mobile browser
entries.status: closed 2026-11-13 (GitHub issue closed by maintainer, stateReason COMPLETED). Not a security finding either way -- out of scope for F4 regardless of tracker state.

entries.title: 98 Python base-image OS-package CVEs excluded by Trivy ignore-unfixed
entries.affected_component: apps/python-api's runtime image base, python:3.12-slim-bookworm (krb5, util-linux, sqlite3, systemd libs, zlib1g, gzip, perl-base, ncurses)
entries.fixed_version: none available -- every suppressed finding's Trivy 'Fixed Version' column was empty at assessment time (status affected/will_not_fix/fix_deferred)
entries.exploitability_context: OS packages present in the image but not invoked by this service's code path (no kadmind/KDC, no sqlite usage, no mount operations); mitigated further by non-root execution, read-only filesystem, and all Linux capabilities dropped (F4 hardening)
entries.evidence: unfiltered Trivy scan preserved in docs/architecture/SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md and reproducible via `trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL <image>` (no ignore-unfixed) against a freshly built image; filtered (0-finding) evidence from the passing CI run referenced in the original PR
entries.remediation: move to a 3.11-compatible distroless Python base or an Alpine/musl rebuild with a build toolchain for the Rust/C-extension dependencies (pydantic_core, uvloop, httptools, watchfiles) -- both rejected in F3 as materially bigger changes than the finding warranted at the time; revisit if a Debian point release ships fixes, or at the next scheduled review
entries.status: closed 2026-11-13 (GitHub issue closed by maintainer, stateReason COMPLETED; no linked PR). The technical control remains live and enforced in CI regardless of issue-tracker state: Trivy's ignore-unfixed exception on apps/python-api's base image is still in force. VEX statements generated per-CVE by cmd/secreport (status: affected, not not_affected -- no per-CVE reachability analysis was done for all 98 individually).
